description: Spread and rest consult get over the source's *own enumerable* members only. A class declares its accessors on the prototype, so spreading an instance — the whole DOM case — touches nothing; an object literal's accessor is own, so spreading it runs the getter.

diagnostics.message: Spreading `literal` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
